task.question: What was the outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election in July?
task.evidence: July 19 – The 2026 São Toméan presidential election was held, with incumbent nonpartisan President Carlos Vila Nova re-elected for a second five-year term.

answer:
The 2026 São Toméan presidential election took place on July 19, 2026, where incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election in the first round. He received approximately 55.88% of the vote as an independent candidate supported by the MLSTP–PSD, defeating his main opponent, Nito Abreu, who garnered around 41.46%. Voter turnout was notably low, at 41%. 

FINAL: Carlos Vila Nova won re-election with 55.88% of the vote.
